newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip across the board.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, as the market was depressed by near-term oversupply trends, traders said.
In addition to rising domestic rubber stocks, news that Japan's August vehicle production fall 2.1 percent on a year-on-year basis, added to the market's bearishness.
Prices ranged from 3.4 yen to 4.7 yen per kg lower. Newly listed benchmark March ended at 136.5 yen after opening at 138.8 yen. Volume was buoyant due to active selling.
"The market is likely to look for the bottom. The benchmark March could test 135 yen," one trader said.
